item.title: Development of the Fruit Peels of Rambutan (Nephelium lappaceum L.) into Herbal Tea
item.description: Rambutan (Nephelium lappaceum) peel contains various bioactive compounds, including phenolics, flavonoids, and ellagic acid, which function as antioxidants. item.title: Modification of CaO from Scallops (Amusium Pleuronectes) with Fe3O4 and SiO2 for Adsorption of Congo Red and Methylene Blue Dye
item.description: Congo Red and Methylene Blue dye waste from the textile industry needs to be treated before being discharged into water bodies. item.title: Stoichiometric Combustion Modeling and Regulatory Compliance Assessment of Indonesian Sub-bituminous Coal: Implications for Clean Coal Technology Deployment
item.description: Coal is an important energy source, but its utilization must consider quality and environmental aspects for sustainability.
